text.p: Perceptronics Inc said on Tuesday it has restated its results for 1996, 1995 and 1994 following an accounting review.
The restatement raised net income for fiscal years 1996 and 1995, reduced revenues for fiscal year 1995, and reduced net income for fiscal year 1994.
The company said in a statement it now reports an operating loss for fiscal 1995 as opposed to a previously stated operating profit although it did not give the size of the operating loss.

For the fiscal year ended March 31, 1996 Perceptronics' restated net income was $116,187, or $0.03 a share, on total revenues of $5,976,618. This compares with net income of $81,235, or $0.02 a share, on total revenues of $5,992,952 for the previously stated figures.

For the fiscal year ended March 31, 1995 Perceptronics' restated net income was $38,131, or $0.01 a share, on total revenues of $5,726,729. This compares with net income of $11,077, or nil per share, on total revenues of $6,140,831 for the previously stated figures.

For the fiscal year ended March 31, 1994 Perceptronics' restated net income was $1,337,465, or $0.36 a share, on total revenues of $5,814,751. This compares with net income of $1,531,276, or $0.41 a share, on the same total revenues, for the previously stated figures.

The restated fiscal year 1994 figures included an extraordinary loss of $192,000 for the cumulative effect through March 31, 1993 of the adoption of SFAS 109, and an extraordinary gain of $3,337,465 from extinguishment of debt.
